Title: Stand-in Tier+Tactical Medical
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Weapon_Package_Medic1 folder name,
the datablock and function names its port covers and the shape of its
scripts, so the listed port applies to it. It is not the original Add-On
and holds none of its files, and its tools, words, sounds and numbers are
its own.
